name: error_handling_adequacy
description: Evaluate whether functions have adequate error handling based on semantic analysis of error propagation patterns.

options.description: Function propagates errors properly using Result types and ? operator or explicit return Err
Function handles errors internally with match/recover patterns
Function ignores errors (unwrap, expect without context, or silent discard)
Function panics on error instead of propagating or recovering

evaluation_factors: Use of ? operator for early return
